# Broad command/tag fixtures for parse↔encode coverage.
# Format: one IRC line per non-comment line.

# JOIN / PART / multi
:nick!u@h JOIN #a
:nick!u@h JOIN #a,#b
:nick!u@h PART #a :bye
:nick!u@h PART #a,#b

# PRIVMSG / NOTICE / STATUSMSG
:nick!u@h PRIVMSG #chan :hello
:nick!u@h PRIVMSG alice :pm
:nick!u@h NOTICE #chan :channel notice
:nick!u@h NOTICE alice :private notice
:nick!u@h PRIVMSG @#chan :ops only statusmsg
:nick!u@h PRIVMSG +#chan :voice statusmsg
:nick!u@h NOTICE @#chan :ops notice

# Server notices / wallops-ish
:irc.example.com NOTICE * :*** Looking up your hostname
:irc.example.com NOTICE nick :Server notice to nick
:oper!o@h WALLOPS :important

# Tags (IRCv3)
@time=2024-01-02T03:04:05.000Z;msgid=abc :nick!u@h PRIVMSG #c :tagged
@account=nick;time=2024-01-02T03:04:05.000Z :nick!u@h NOTICE #c :tagged notice
@+typing=active :nick!u@h TAGMSG #c
@label=xyz;batch=ref :irc.example.com NOTICE nick :labeled

# KICK / QUIT
:op!u@h KICK #chan victim :go away
:nick!u@h QUIT :Client Quit
:nick!u@h QUIT

# User modes / channel modes / list modes
:nick!u@h MODE nick +i
:nick!u@h MODE nick -i+w
:nick!u@h MODE #chan +nt
:nick!u@h MODE #chan +o alice
:nick!u@h MODE #chan +v-o bob alice
:nick!u@h MODE #chan +b *!*@spam.example
:nick!u@h MODE #chan +k secret
:nick!u@h MODE #chan +l 42
:nick!u@h MODE #chan +beI *!*@a *!*@b nick!*@*
:irc.example.com 367 nick #chan *!*@spam.example setter 1710000000
:irc.example.com 368 nick #chan :End of Channel Ban List
:irc.example.com 324 nick #chan +ntk secret
:irc.example.com 329 nick #chan 1710000000

# Numerics often seen around joins
:irc.example.com 353 nick = #chan :@alice +bob carol
:irc.example.com 366 nick #chan :End of /NAMES list.
:irc.example.com 332 nick #chan :topic text
:irc.example.com 333 nick #chan setter 1710000000
